identity.fantasy: A spider-form ambusher who applies corrosive toxins through bites, burrows into pursuit, and detonates venom during execute pressure.
identity.one_line: A spider-form ambusher who applies corrosive toxins through bites, burrows into pursuit, and detonates venom during execute pressure. The defining decision is contextual: At five points, remaining Rootfang time determines refresh versus Widowmaker.

mechanics.core_loop: A spider-form ambusher using Widowmaker, bites, corrosive toxins, brood effects, burrow/pursuit, and venom detonations. It is more direct than Venom but more position-dependent, with strong PvP-shaped control and execute pressure.
mechanics.single_target: From stealth, use Brood Trap and Venom Fang, apply Withering, build with three Nerubian Stings, then Rootfang plus Contagion. At five combo points, use Widowmaker only when Rootfang has more than roughly five seconds left; otherwise refresh first.
mechanics.aoe: Apply Nerubian Sting across targets, reach five combo points, then use Face Melter or Widowmaker. One high-level player reports this dungeon loop while also describing the spec very negatively.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Burrow and pursuit create strong access, but the spec remains highly position-dependent.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Widowmaker, Rotfang, Virulent Opening, Black Widow.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Withering Venom, Potency, Rotting Sores, Tunneler, Brood Lord.
